title: Remove the Bad People
content:
it's time for another post, this time i want to say another important thing.
don't keep the bad people in your life. realize who those people really are to you, do they contribute positively to your life? if not, cut them out.
it's alright to feel bad for doing so, but don't let yourself get dragged down, especially if those people refuse to stand up on their own.
eventually, you will see how good or bad they were for you, and if it's meant to be, they will find their way back. it's important to not try to force it, though, as that could just put you back where you started.
